value: Daltry finds no record of Velinde staying at the inn. That silence is limited to the records he knows; it cannot prove she never passed through Darkshire. But when the seeker describes the wolf-men, the clerk has heard of them. He points toward the Carevin household, whose hunters work against monsters in the wood. The search has found no lodging entry and no living witness to Velinde’s arrival. It has found a local lead: a mine to the south where the worgen were first encountered.
